messages:
deploy-bot: [2026-03-15 14:12:25 UTC] Canary rollout started for release r1.14.0-canary. Target: /api/generate. Image: redwood/inference:1.14.0-canary. Canary traffic 5% -> 20% over 10m. Link: https://deploys.redwood/internal/r/1234

Ivan: seeing spike of 502s in canary pods at +4m. Rolling average error 12% on canary route. Logs:
```
ERROR 502 upstream timeout kv-cache.cpp:312
stack: ...
```

Dev-platform: auto-rollback kicked at +6m but some pods stuck terminating. Can someone check kube events? `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide --selector=release=r1.14.0-canary`

Amber (on-call): I'm paged. Paging @Elaine @Mike. Creating incident INC-2026-847 in PagerDuty. Affected: hosted API customers, generator route. Initial customer impact estimate: ~8% of prod requests hitting canary.

Elaine (eng-sre): I'm picking up. Assigning baseline: scale down canary to 0% and promote previous stable. Suggest manual rollback to image redwood/inference:1.13.9. Steps:
```
# scale canary down
kubectl patch trafficsplit canary --type='json' -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/serviceWeights/canary","value":0}]'
# update k8s deployment
kubectl set image deployment/inference-api inference=redwood/inference:1.13.9 -n inference
```

Dev-platform: note: there's a known issue where pod termination hangs if the grpc proxy hasn't closed streams; do a `kubectl rollout restart` if pods not terminating after 30s.

Ivan: running the scale down now. Patching trafficsplit -> `ok`.

Mike (support): Customer A reported elevated error rates at 14:16 UTC. Others on Slack complaining. Public status page: rudimentary incident message posted.

Elaine (eng-sre): issuing `kubectl set image` -> observed image pull success and new pods coming up. One old pod stuck in Terminating for 90s, did `kubectl delete pod <pod>` and it terminated.

deploy-bot: Auto-rollback attempted earlier at 14:18:37 UTC — partially successful: 60% of canary traffic reverted, but the control-plane race left 2% traffic still to canary.

Amber (on-call): I'm coordinating with SRE to hold traffic until verification. Product-ops @Nora, any sensitive customers? We need to notify enterprise accounts if they saw anomalies.

Nora (product-ops): Notified enterprise SOCs via email, asked for logs. No SEC-level impact reported. Some customers had degraded p99 latency (~1.2s -> 3.8s) on generate.

Elaine (eng-sre): running smoke tests: curl /health, /api/generate with short prompt, checking embeddings. All green now. Verifying traces show request flow to stable model.

Ivan: load testing small ramp at 20rps, error rate returning to baseline <0.1%.

Amber (on-call): Confirming mitigation: manual rollback completed at 14:25 UTC. Incident status: mitigation in place, customer impact degrading. Creating follow-up thread and postmortem.

Elaine (eng-sre): Post-rollback verification checklist done:
- smoke tests pass
- canary traffic 0%
- no stuck pods
- no new errors in logs for 10m

Mike (support): Close loop with Customer A; offered credit and detailed timeline.

Dev-platform: Action items: add pre-rollout healthcheck for grpc stream draining, extend auto-rollback to verify full traffic revert before closing.

Amber (on-call): Incident resolved at 14:30 UTC. Will open INC-2026-847 postmortem with owners: @Elaine (sre) - remediation, @Dev-platform - rollout fixes, @Product-ops - customer comms.

(Reaction: :white_check_mark:)
